from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    comps = []
    while cells:
        start = cells.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = [start]
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in cells:
                    cells.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    source = max(comps, key=len)
    sr = [r for r,c in source]; sc = [c for r,c in source]
    top, left, bottom, right = min(sr), min(sc), max(sr), max(sc)
    cr, cc = (top+bottom)//2, (left+right)//2
    pattern = {(r-cr, c-cc, grid[r][c]) for r,c in source}
    markers = [p for comp in comps if comp is not source for p in comp]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        out[r][c] = bg
        for dr,dc,color in pattern:
            rr, col = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                out[rr][col] = color
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo_in = [[7]*10 for _ in range(21)]
    pixels = {(6,4):3,(6,7):1,(6,8):1,(6,9):0,(7,7):0,(7,8):4,(7,9):0,(8,7):0,(8,8):1,(8,9):5,(9,7):4,(9,8):4,(10,7):0,(14,7):3,(15,3):3}
    for (r,c),v in pixels.items(): demo_in[r][c]=v
    exp = [[7]*10 for _ in range(21)]
    ep={(4,3):1,(4,4):1,(4,5):0,(5,3):0,(5,4):4,(5,5):0,(6,3):0,(6,4):1,(6,5):5,(7,3):4,(7,4):4,(8,3):0,
        (6,7):1,(6,8):1,(6,9):0,(7,7):0,(7,8):4,(7,9):0,(8,7):0,(8,8):1,(8,9):5,(9,7):4,(9,8):4,(10,7):0,
        (12,6):1,(12,7):1,(12,8):0,(13,6):0,(13,7):4,(13,8):0,(14,6):0,(14,7):1,(14,8):5,(15,6):4,(15,7):4,(16,6):0,
        (13,2):1,(13,3):1,(13,4):0,(14,2):0,(14,3):4,(14,4):0,(15,2):0,(15,3):1,(15,4):5,(16,2):4,(16,3):4,(17,2):0}
    for (r,c),v in ep.items(): exp[r][c]=v
    assert transform(demo_in)==exp
